programmes.d: At the diner, Hector tries to talk Jake into giving him money to invest in coffee futures, but Jake resists.
Joe and Helen learn to deal with their "overly neighborly" neighbors.
Joe and Helen find themselves celebrating their first year anniversary at a "SinglesMingle."
The suicide hotline proves to be good for Antonio. Helen competes with a gourmet foodcart
When a passenger leaves a cooler containing "The Gift of Life" in the terminal, the gangfeels responsible to return it.
As Matthew tries enlisting everyone to participate in a summer house, Dave, Bill and Jimmy join forces to complete a new promotional spot for the station.
A building fire brings Lisa and Dave back together; Joe balks at the installation of new surveillance cameras; and Jimmy ponders marrying a woman he's rejected once before.
Over Dave and Lisa's objections, Jimmy decides to run for president.
An annual review of the station sparks problems; Matthew quits over a story he isn't allowed to do.
When Andi gets Bev (Swoosie Kurtz) a spot volunteering at the hospital, Joe becomes bored and starts spending too much time with Adam.
When Andi and Adam disagree about Kate attending a dance with an older boy, Adam tries to outsmart Andi to win the argument.
Adam attempts to organize a birthday dinner for Andi and he discovers that managing guests isn't easy.
When Adam and Andi lose footage of an intimate moment they accidentally recorded, they have to track it down before anyone can see it.
Doug and Carrie get free tickets to her firm's annual golf outing at a private club.
Doug starts to dream more seriously about running his sandwich shop now that his Uncle Stu (guest star Gavin MacLeod) has generously offered him a large sum of money to see him realize his dream.
While Carrie is away on a business trip, Doug plays host to his parents and seems to re-live his youth while doing it.
Carrie starts Doug on another new diet which makes him miserable.
Now that Reggie is gone, John tells Chris he has feelings for her (Chris).
John sits on his fire escape, smoking a cigar, the smoke from which is wafting into Chris's open window directly above.
As John and Jake chat about Chris at the diner, Bob rushes in and announces that he just saw Chris naked when he went to fix her faucet.
Becker has a videotape of a French film that he plans to use to lure Chris into coming over to his place.
Becker tries to discourage a friend from expressing interest in Chris by telling him that she is gay.
At the diner, Chris is in the kitchen when a robber enters.
Finch refuses to be recognized on Secretary's Day; Nina ponders plastic surgery.
A session to get a new photo ID inspires Maya's erotic dreams about Elliott.
Maya's tireless efforts for charity are overshadowed by her father's large cash donation.
Maya's experiment has unexpected consequences as Jack sets out to assemble a toy for his baby and Nina relishes her role in a practical joke on Finch.
Sandpiper Air begins to fly for a country music tour. When the tour falls apart, the newowner disappears.
The real reason Clayton Industries purchased Sandpiper is revealed.
This year, Christmas Eve is spent in a cab with a nun, in a department store basementhiding from carolers.
Joe and Helen's sex life gets wrapped into Roy's relationship with a TV talk show host.

Joe buys a new state of the art vacuum cleaner only to learn that it's life time guaranteedoesn't hold.
Brian saves the day when he lands a plane.
Returning from an idyllic honeymoon in the sunny tropics, Joe and Helen learn their house has burned to the ground.
Joe is indignant about throwing his brother, Brian, out of his life until he receives a visit from the ghost of his father.
Joe and Brian are paid to fly the deceased old man Kingsbury back to Nantucket and accidentally bring back the wrong body so Joe has to pose as a corpse.

Lowell returns to Nantucket after seeing America and immediately needs to fly to Boston to repair one of Roy's planes. While in Boston, Lowell witnesses a gangland murder and is forced to enter the Federal Witness Protection Program.
While accompanying Carrie (Leah Remini) in her attempts to befriend her new co-workers, Doug (Kevin James) sabotages the relationships to avoid any future obligations on his part.
Doug (Kevin James) decides an emergency road trip is in order after Spence (Patton Oswalt) learns his ex-girlfriend is getting married in Tennessee.
Arthur (Jerry Stiller) persuades Doug (Kevin James) to compete with him in a shuffleboard tournament at the senior center.
Holly (Nicole Sullivan) moves in with Doug (Kevin James) and Carrie (Leah Remini) after being kicked out of her apartment.
When Adam's client offers him two highly coveted tickets to a Pittsburgh Steelers game, he must choose between taking his wife, Andi, or his brother, Don (Kevin Nealon).
When Adam gets fed up with endless demands from his daughter's kindergarten teacher, Mrs. Rodriguez, he makes a hasty decision that lands him in hot water with his wife Andi.
When Don encourages Adam to clean out his cluttered garage and turn it into a man cave, Adam panics when he thinks he donated one of Andi's treasured keepsakes.
Andi has a hard time not taking over when Adam tackles organizing the school's big Thanksgiving feast with Don and Lowell.
After Alan falls off the roof trying to fix the satellite dish, Charlie volunteers to take care of Jake for the weekend.
When Jake's school principal demands to meet immediately with Alan concerning a picture Jake drew of a large-breasted schoolmate, Alan leaves a message asking Charlie to help.
Charlie is dismayed to learn that Alan's recent dating spree has been with Alan's ex-wife, Judith. Charlie fears he will rarely get to see Jake if Alan and Judith reconcile.
